name: sea-tryon
description: Build and test tooling for the Sea Try-On WooCommerce extension.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build assets/src/frontend.js assets/src/admin.js blocks/virtual-try-on/virtual-try-on-editor.js --output-path=assets/build && npm run build:strip-maps && npm run build:verify
scripts.format: wp-scripts format assets/src blocks/virtual-try-on scripts package.json .wp-env.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
